questions: Section 5 says the total cholesterol table and the ratio table are both in force, but it also sends me to judgement where two tables point at different bands. On this file TC 256 scores 25 and ratio 6.1 scores 25: do I add them for 50, or charge only the single worse band for 25?

Section 16 sends combinations of cardiac risk factors to judgement. This file has BMI 29.9, untreated BP 144/85, TC 256 with ratio 6.1 and A1c 6.8 all together. Does the house add a further debit on top of the summed table debits for that cluster, and if so how many points?
A1c 6.8 with no diabetes diagnosis and no medication: do I charge the full 50 from the section 6 table, or does the absence of a diagnosis reduce or remove that charge?
With blood pressure 144/85 untreated and A1c 6.8 untreated and unworked-up on a 53-year-old, does the house rate this file as it stands, or postpone it pending treatment or repeat readings?
